lines: Agnes the Stripling           St:18 Dx:13 Co:18 In:7 Wi:9 Ch:8 Neutral

notes: Turn 12, HP 4 of 16 with a hostile jackal adjacent (north-east); the hill orc was killed by the kitten. HP 4 counts as major trouble, but the prayer timeout starts at 300 and must be below 200, so praying on turn 12 would not help. Retreat, fight the weak jackal carefully, or flee upstairs.
